图着色的对比神经算法推理Contrastive Neural Algorithmic Reasoning for Graph Coloring

Thien Le
Harvard University
SEAS
thien_le@seas.harvard.edu    Tianyu Zhao
Harvard University

tzhao1@hsph.harvard.edu    Melanie Weber

摘要Abstract

图形着色旨在为图形的节点分配颜色，以便相邻节点使用尽可能少的颜色接收不同的颜色。在这里，我们研究近似Graph coloring seeks to assigns colors to a graph’s nodes so that adjacent nodes receive different colors, using as few colors as possible. Here, we study approximatekk- 着色，目标是最多使用-coloring, where the goal is to use at mostkk颜色，同时最大限度地减少单色边缘的数量。这个问题是图论的核心，在调度和资源分配等领域有应用。最近的无监督 GNN 方法直接优化每个实例，排除了跨图大小和分布的泛化。相反，我们提出了一种对比学习框架，该框架学习可转移的着色几何形状，其中相同颜色节点的嵌入对齐，而相邻节点的表示被推向不同的方向。我们在有限大小的图表上分析由此产生的人口目标。对于单位范数嵌入，我们表明其最优值具有线原型结构：相同颜色的节点的表示折叠到共享的一维子空间，并且边连接正交子空间。这种几何结构在监督环境中产生平稳条件，并在平衡着色假设下通过投影次梯度动力学得以保留。在非标准化变体中，梯度下降具有由商图硬边际问题控制的最大边际偏差。对合成图和真实世界图的实验表明，对比 GNN 编码器可以有效泛化并产生低冲突的着色、匹配，有时还可以改进贪婪方法。colors while minimizing the number of monochromatic edges. This problem is central to graph theory and has applications in areas such as scheduling and resource allocation. Recent unsupervised GNN approaches optimize each instance directly, precluding generalization across graph sizes and distributions. We instead propose a contrastive learning framework that learns transferable coloring geometry where the embeddings of same-color nodes align, while adjacent nodes’ representations are pushed toward distinct directions. We analyze the resulting population objective over bounded-size graphs. For unit-norm embeddings, we show that its optima have a line-prototype structure: Representations of nodes of the same color collapse to a shared one-dimensional subspace, and edges connect orthogonal subspaces. This geometry yields stationarity conditions in the supervised setting and is preserved by projected subgradient dynamics under a balanced-coloring assumption. In an unnormalized variant, gradient descent has a max-margin bias governed by a quotient-graph hard-margin problem. Experiments on synthetic and real-world graphs show that contrastive GNN encoders generalize effectively and produce low-conflict colorings, matching and sometimes improving on greedy approaches.

1 简介Introduction

图着色是离散优化中的典型问题。给定一个图Graph coloring is a canonical problem in discrete optimization. Given a graphG=(V,E)G=(V,E)，目标是将颜色分配给顶点，以便相邻顶点接收不同的颜色，同时最小化所使用的颜色总数。这个最小值称为色数。经典硬度结果表明，对于任何, the goal is to assign colors to vertices such that adjacent vertices receive distinct colors, while minimizing the total number of colors used. This minimum is known as the chromatic number. Classical hardness results show that, for anyϵ>0\epsilon>0，在一个因子内近似色数, approximating the chromatic number within a factor ofO​(n1−ϵ)O(n^{1-\epsilon})是 NP 困难的is NP-hard[33, 13, 6, 5]。尽管存在这种最坏情况的棘手性，但图形着色因其广泛的应用而受到持续关注，例如资源分配和调度，其中颜色对应于资源，边缘对应于资源使用中的冲突。在实践中，诸如贪心算法之类的启发式算法. Despite this worst-case intractability, graph coloring has received sustained interest because of its broad range of applications, such as resource allocation and scheduling, where colors correspond to resources and edges to conflicts in resource usage. In practice, heuristics such as greedy algorithms[3]和基于 SAT 的求解器and SAT-based solvers[28, 7]用于解决现实世界的实例。最近，引入了无监督机器学习方法are used to solve real-world instances. More recently, unsupervised machine learning approaches have been introduced[27, 31]，通常通过物理启发的损失来学习颜色逻辑。, typically learning color logits through a physics-inspired loss.

虽然这些方法适用于任意图，但它们要么提供有限的可解释性（贪婪/基于 SAT 的求解器），要么缺乏整合有关测试图的先验知识的机制（无监督学习）。结果是很难While these methods apply to arbitrary graphs, they either offer limited interpretability (greedy/ SAT-based solvers) or lack a mechanism for incorporating prior knowledge about the test graphs (unsupervised learning). As a result, it is difficult先验的a priori来描述它们可能表现良好的图形类别，这使得使用特定图形系列的从业者评估其有效性变得具有挑战性。此外，基于 SAT 的求解器和无监督学习方法通​​常独立优化每个图实例，这在计算上可能会很昂贵。我们提出了一个从两个维度解决这些限制的管道：to characterize the graph classes on which they are likely to perform well, making it challenging for practitioners working with specific graph families to assess their effectiveness. Moreover, SAT-based solvers and unsupervised learning methods typically optimize each graph instance independently, which can be computationally expensive. We propose a pipeline that addresses these limitations along two dimensions:可解释性interpretability，通过利用节点表示的几何形状，以及, by leveraging the geometry of node representations, and可扩展性和领域知识整合scalability and domain-knowledge incorporation，通过采用监督学习框架。这些目标是紧密相连的。由于最佳着色在不受限制的输入上计算起来很困难，因此不应期望单一方法能够完全通用地解决该问题。相反，很自然地利用节点嵌入中存在的简化几何结构来限制感兴趣的图族。, by adopting a supervised learning framework. These goals are closely connected. Since optimal coloring is computationally intractable on unrestricted inputs, one should not expect a single method to solve the problem in full generality. Instead, it is natural to exploit the simplifying geometric structure present in node embeddings for restricted graph families of interest.

我们的方法利用对比学习来提供图形着色的简单表示级视图。给定着色，分配相同颜色的顶点被视为正对，而相邻顶点被视为负对。我们使用 InfoNCE 的绝对值变体训练 GNN 编码器：目标不是对齐有向向量，而是对齐无向线。在这个几何结构下，每种颜色都由一个表示Our approach leverages contrastive learning to provide a simple representation-level view of graph coloring. Given a coloring, vertices assigned the same color are treated as positive pairs, while adjacent vertices are treated as negative pairs. We train a GNN encoder using an absolute-value variant of InfoNCE: rather than aligning directed vectors, the objective aligns unoriented lines. Under this geometry, each color is represented by a原型prototype，对应于一维子空间，并且该颜色的顶点可以沿着同一条线映射到任一方向。然后，解码包括将每条原型线规范化为球体上的一个点，然后对所得嵌入进行聚类以确定顶点颜色。我们提出的算法如图 1 所示。, corresponding to a one-dimensional subspace, and vertices of that color may be mapped to either direction along the same line. Decoding then consists of canonicalizing each prototype line to a point on the sphere, followed by clustering the resulting embeddings to determine vertex colors. Our proposed algorithms is schematically shown in Fig.1.

1.2 相关作品Related works

图形着色长期以来一直作为有效优化限制的中心测试用例。这段历史激发了放松和证书，而不仅仅是精确的恢复。我们的工作在精神上最接近着色的几何松弛，包括矢量着色、半定规划松弛和 Lovász 的 theta 函数Graph coloring has long served as a central test case for the limits of efficient optimization. This history motivates relaxations and certificates, not exact recovery alone. Our work is closest in spirit to geometric relaxations of coloring, including vector colorings, semidefinite programming relaxations, and Lovász’s theta function[13, 21]。我们的出发点不同：我们不是求解 SDP，而是询问学习的对比表示何时产生相关的正交几何。. We differ in the starting point: instead of solving an SDP, we ask when a learned contrastive representation produces the relevant orthogonality geometry.

尽管我们的重点是图形着色的监督学习，但存在大量的 SAT 求解器Although our focus is on supervised learning of graph coloring, there exists a prolific line of SAT solvers[28]和神经算法推理来解决无监督着色问题and neural algorithmic reasoning to tackle unsupervised coloring[27, 31]。虽然无监督方法的性能不受训练数据集选择的影响，但在推理时，它们的运行速度要慢得多，因为它们试图在没有任何数据先验的情况下从头开始解决着色问题。. While the performances of the unsupervised approaches are not affected by the choice of training datasets, at inference time, they run much more slowly as they attempt to solve the coloring problem from scratch without any data priors.

线塌陷现象与监督分类中的神经塌陷有关，其中类内特征塌陷和类均值通常接近单纯形 ETF 几何The line-collapse phenomenon is related to neural collapse in supervised classification, where within-class features collapse and class means often approach a simplex ETF geometry[24]。我们的设置的不同之处在于，平稳方程取决于加权商图，而不仅仅是类平衡。. Our setting differs in that stationary equations depend on the weighted quotient graph rather than only on class balance.

与标准 InfoNCE 损失相比，该目标不鼓励相邻颜色成为对映颜色。相反，它支持嵌入，其中相同颜色的顶点位于公共的无方向线上，而边缘相邻的顶点位于正交方向。稍后我们将使用这种形式的分色来通过 Lovász 获取可着色性证书Compared to the standard InfoNCE loss, this objective does not encourage neighboring colors to be antipodal. Instead, it favors embeddings in which same-color vertices lie on a common unoriented line, while edge-adjacent vertices lie in orthogonal directions. We will later use this form of color separation to obtain colorability certificates via Lovászϑ\vartheta边界bounds[21].

Intuitively,Thm.˜3说一旦我们限制将每个最佳颜色类折叠为单线原型的嵌入，监督绝对值损失就成为这些原型上的有限加权球形代码问题。权重并不统一：它们取决于每个节点在其他颜色类别中拥有多少个邻居以及相应的 InfoNCE 分母。对于每种颜色，当所有其他颜色线施加的加权“力”没有与球体相切的分量时，折叠的原型配置恰好是静止的。says that once we restrict to embeddings that collapse each optimal color class to a single line prototype, the supervised absolute-value loss becomes a finite weighted spherical-code problem over those prototypes. The weights are not uniform: they depend on how many neighbors each node has in the other color classes and on the corresponding InfoNCE denominators. A collapsed prototype configuration is stationary exactly when, for every color, the weighted “force” exerted by all other color lines has no component tangent to the sphere.

更重要的是，我们目标的局部最优仅通过每种颜色的计数与图形结构交互More importantly, local optima of our objective only interact with the graph structures via the per-color countsdv,jd_{v,j}。下一节将利用这种依赖性来识别图平衡条件，以确保基于梯度的算法处于有利的状态。. This dependence is exploited in the next sections to identify graph balancedness conditions that ensure gradient-based algorithms land in a favorable regime.

8 讨论与结论Discussion and Conclusion

我们引入了一种用于监督图着色的绝对值对比框架，并表明它会产生精确的线原型几何形状：相同颜色的顶点折叠到常见的无向线上，而相邻的颜色类别则被驱动为正交。这种几何形状产生由着色商图控制的平稳方程，并在实现正交性时实现 Lovász 式着色性认证。根据经验，对比 GNN 编码器提供快速可重用的着色，并显示出有希望的大小和 OOD 泛化能力。We introduced an absolute-value contrastive framework for supervised graph coloring and showed that it induces a precise line-prototype geometry: same-color vertices collapse onto common unoriented lines, while adjacent color classes are driven toward orthogonality. This geometry yields stationary equations governed by the coloring quotient graph, and enables Lovász-style colorability certification when orthogonality is achieved. Empirically, contrastive GNN encoders provide fast reusable colorings and show promising size and OOD generalization.

局限性和未来的工作。Limitations and future work.虽然强全局最优特征很明显，但我们的动态不变性结果进一步假设了公平的最佳着色，这使得同一颜色类别内的顶点与投影的次梯度动态无法区分。如果没有这种对称性，就不需要沿着完整的训练轨迹保留精确的原型崩溃。未来的一项令人兴奋的工作可以利用不同下游聚类算法的稳定性特性来放松这种崩溃假设。While the strong global optima characterization is sharp, our dynamical invariance result further assumes an equitable optimal coloring, which makes vertices within the same color class indistinguishable to the projected subgradient dynamics. Without this symmetry, exact prototype collapse needs not be preserved along the full training trajectory. An exciting line of future work could use stability properties of different downstream clustering algorithms to relax this collapse assumption.

其次，实证结果表明，架构和特征选择的准确性各不相同，因此该框架并未提出一种针对监督神经图着色的万能解决方案。Secondly, the empirical results show that architecture and feature choices vary accuracies, so the framework does not suggest a one-size-fits-all solution to supervised neural graph coloring.

未来，通过样本复杂性或分布转移保证，为特定图族的这种方法开发更强大的泛化理论也是令人兴奋的。根据经验，探索监督学习和无监督学习之间的混合设计（如我们的 v2 变体）可能会提高我们方法的实用性。In the future, it is also exciting to develop stronger generalization theory for this approach for specific graph families via a sample-complexity or distribution-shift guarantee. Empirically, exploring a hybrid design between supervised and unsupervised learning (as in our v2 variant) may improve practicality of our method.

一点A pointxx对于无约束问题，称为克拉克平稳is called Clarke stationary for the unconstrained problem

对于约束变量或多值变量，必须仅沿可行方向施加平稳性条件。让For constrained or manifold-valued variables, the stationarity condition must be imposed only along feasible directions. 克拉克黎曼平稳性（例如Clarke Riemannian stationarity (e.g.[10]).

一点A pointx∈ℳx\in\mathcal{M}克拉克黎曼平稳吗is Clarke Riemannian stationary for

minx∈ℳ⁡f​(x)\min_{x\in\mathcal{M}}f(x)

等效地，切空间上不存在克拉克方向导数证明的一阶下降方向。在光滑的情况下，这个条件成为通常的黎曼一阶条件Equivalently, there is no first-order descent direction certified by the Clarke directional derivative on the tangent space. In the smooth case this condition becomes the usual Riemannian first-order condition

gradℳ⁡f​(x)=0.\operatorname{grad}_{\mathcal{M}}f(x)=0. (23)

在本文中，相关的非光滑性来自绝对值，而相关的约束通常对球体的乘积进行嵌入。因此，克拉克黎曼平稳性是适当的一阶概念：它捕获目标的非光滑几何形状，同时尊重表示流形的可行切线方向。In this paper, the relevant nonsmoothness comes from absolute values, while the relevant constraints often place embeddings on products of spheres. Clarke Riemannian stationarity is therefore the appropriate first-order notion: it captures the nonsmooth geometry of the objective while respecting the feasible tangent directions of the representation manifold.

F.3 寻找合适的编码器Finding the right encoders

F.3.1 编码器实现Encoder implementations

扫描中的所有编码器都使用原始 CORA BOW 输入特征、两个编码器层、隐藏维度 128 和 dropout 0.1（如果适用）。All encoders in the sweep use raw CORA BOW input features, two encoder layers, hidden dimension 128, and dropout 0.1 where applicable.

甘肃gcn：原始PyG: the original PyGGCNConv以前的 CORA 管道中使用的编码器。它不使用自循环，在层之间应用 ReLU，并且不使用残差连接或归一化。encoder used in the previous CORA pipeline. It uses no self-loops, applies ReLU between layers, and does not use residual connections or normalization.

res_gcn：自定义残差 GCN，输入投影到隐藏维度，重复: a custom residual GCN with input projection to hidden dimension, repeatedGCNConv、ReLU、dropout、残差加法和 LayerNorm。, ReLU, dropout, residual addition, and LayerNorm.

杜松子酒gin：PyG: PyGGIN转换GINConv。每层都使用两层 MLP，可训练. Each layer uses a two-layer MLP with trainableϵ\epsilon、残差加法、LayerNorm、ReLU 和 dropout。, residual addition, LayerNorm, ReLU, and dropout.

门控_gcngated_gcn：没有边缘特征的自定义向量门控残差消息传递编码器。门是根据源节点和目标节点状态计算的，门控消息在残差 LayerNorm 更新之前进行度归一化。: a custom vector-gated residual message-passing encoder with no edge features. The gate is computed from source and target node states, and gated messages are degree-normalized before the residual LayerNorm update.

圣人sage：PyG: PyGSAGEConv具有 ReLU 和层之间的 dropout，并且没有残余连接。with ReLU and dropout between layers and no residual connection.

盖特gat：PyG: PyGGAT转换GATConv隐藏层有 4 个注意力头，层间有 ELU 和 dropout，并且没有残差连接。with 4 attention heads in hidden layers, ELU and dropout between layers, and no residual connection.

全球定位系统gps：PyG: PyGGPS转换GPSConv;本地模块是; the local module isGCNConv，全局模块是 4 个头的多头自注意力。, and the global module is multi-head self-attention with 4 heads.

gps_gcn / gps_sage / gps_gin / gps_gat：GPSConv 变体保留相同的全局多头自注意力块，但替换了本地消息传递模块: GPSConv variants that keep the same global multi-head self-attention block but replace the local message-passing module withGCNConv, SAGEConv, GIN转换GINConv, 或, orGAT转换GATConv，分别。, respectively.

图维特graph_vit：自定义图形令牌 Transformer 编码器。节点特征被投影到隐藏维度并由两层处理: a custom graph-token Transformer encoder. Node features are projected to hidden dimension and processed by a two-layer变压器编码器TransformerEncoder;不使用显式的图形位置编码。; no explicit graph positional encoding is used.

探索者exphormer：一个轻量级的 Exphormer 风格的稀疏注意力编码器，其中注意力是在原始图边缘、自边缘和 4 度的确定性扩展器风格边缘上计算的。: a lightweight Exphormer-style sparse-attention encoder where attention is computed over original graph edges, self-edges, and deterministic expander-style edges with degree 4.

单一_mpunitary_mp：实值统一式消息传递编码器。每层都使用凯莱变换正交映射来表示自身和邻居消息、度归一化聚合、学习的自身/消息混合系数、残差加法和 LayerNorm。: a real-valued unitary-style message-passing encoder. Each layer uses Cayley-transform orthogonal maps for self and neighbor messages, degree-normalized aggregation, a learned self/message mixing coefficient, residual addition, and LayerNorm.

下面更详细地描述了三个最相关的编码器。The three most relevant encoders are described in more detail below.

GatedGCN 式编码器。GatedGCN-style encoder.

性能最好的编码器是自定义的 GatedGCN 样式层。对于节点状态The best-performing encoder is a custom GatedGCN-style layer. For node statehuh_{u}，每个有向边, each directed edge(u,v)(u,v)计算向量门和门控消息computes a vector gate and gated message

gu​v=σ​(Ws​hu+Wt​hv),mu​v=Wm​hu⊙gu​v.g_{uv}=\sigma(W_{s}h_{u}+W_{t}h_{v}),\qquad m_{uv}=W_{m}h_{u}\odot g_{uv}.

消息进入节点Messages into nodevv度归一化并与自变换相结合：are degree-normalized and combined with a self transformation:

h~v=W0​hv+1max⁡(1,deg⁡v)​∑u:(u,v)∈Emu​v.\tilde{h}_{v}=W_{0}h_{v}+\frac{1}{\max(1,\deg v)}\sum_{u:(u,v)\in E}m_{uv}.

该层的输出为The layer output is

hvout=LayerNorm​(hv+Dropout​(ReLU​(h~v))).h_{v}^{\mathrm{out}}=\mathrm{LayerNorm}\left(h_{v}+\mathrm{Dropout}(\mathrm{ReLU}(\tilde{h}_{v}))\right).

此设计使用向量值门、残差连接和 LayerNorm，但不使用边缘特征。This design uses vector-valued gates, residual connections, and LayerNorm, but does not use edge features.

残差 GCN 编码器。Residual GCN encoder.

残差 GCN 使用与原始 GCN 基线相同的局部聚合族，但用残差归一化包装每个层：The residual GCN uses the same local aggregation family as the original GCN baseline, but wraps each layer with residual normalization:

h~(ℓ+1)=ReLU​(GCNConv​(h(ℓ),E)),\tilde{h}^{(\ell+1)}=\mathrm{ReLU}(\mathrm{GCNConv}(h^{(\ell)},E)),
h(ℓ+1)=LayerNorm​(h(ℓ)+Dropout​(h~(ℓ+1))).h^{(\ell+1)}=\mathrm{LayerNorm}\left(h^{(\ell)}+\mathrm{Dropout}(\tilde{h}^{(\ell+1)})\right).

这区分了改进是否来自更稳定的残差/归一化 GCN 架构，而不是来自注意力或全局混合。This isolates whether the improvement comes from a more stable residual/normalized GCN architecture rather than from attention or global mixing.

单一消息传递编码器。Unitary message-passing encoder.

unitary_mp 编码器是实值正交/酉式消息传递模型。它不是一个复值酉神经网络；相反，每一层都通过凯莱变换将其自身和消息变换限制为正交。对于可训练的方阵The unitary_mp encoder is a real-valued orthogonal/unitary-style message-passing model. It is not a complex-valued unitary neural network; instead, each layer constrains its self and message transformations to be orthogonal through a Cayley transform. For a trainable square matrixAA，斜对称部分是, the skew-symmetric part is

S=A−A⊤,S=A-A^{\top},

对应的正交映射为and the corresponding orthogonal map is

Q​(A)=(I−S)​(I+S)−1.Q(A)=(I-S)(I+S)^{-1}.

每层对自身状态和邻居消息使用单独的正交映射：Each layer uses separate orthogonal maps for the self state and neighbor messages:

qv=Qself​hv,ru=Qmsg​hu.q_{v}=Q_{\mathrm{self}}h_{v},\qquad r_{u}=Q_{\mathrm{msg}}h_{u}.

邻居消息是平均聚合的，Neighbor messages are mean-aggregated,

r¯v=1max⁡(1,deg⁡v)​∑u:(u,v)∈Eru,\bar{r}_{v}=\frac{1}{\max(1,\deg v)}\sum_{u:(u,v)\in E}r_{u},

然后与学过的门混合and then mixed with a learned gateβ∈[0,1]\beta\in[0,1]:

h~v=β​qv+(1−β)​r¯v.\tilde{h}_{v}=\beta q_{v}+(1-\beta)\bar{r}_{v}.

该层输出使用与其他稳定 MP 编码器相同的残差归一化形式：The layer output uses the same residual-normalized form as the other stable MP encoders:

hvout=LayerNorm​(hv+Dropout​(ReLU​(h~v))).h_{v}^{\mathrm{out}}=\mathrm{LayerNorm}\left(h_{v}+\mathrm{Dropout}(\mathrm{ReLU}(\tilde{h}_{v}))\right).

该编码器测试之前保持规范的消息转换是否稳定嵌入This encoder tests whether norm-preserving message transformations stabilize the embeddings beforekk-medoids 解码。-medoids decoding.

GatedGCN 式编码器。GatedGCN-style encoder.

性能最好的编码器是自定义的 GatedGCN 样式层。对于节点状态The best-performing encoder is a custom GatedGCN-style layer. For node statehuh_{u}，每个有向边, each directed edge(u,v)(u,v)计算向量门和门控消息computes a vector gate and gated message

残差 GCN 编码器。Residual GCN encoder.

残差 GCN 使用与原始 GCN 基线相同的局部聚合族，但用残差归一化包装每个层：The residual GCN uses the same local aggregation family as the original GCN baseline, but wraps each layer with residual normalization:

h~(ℓ+1)=ReLU​(GCNConv​(h(ℓ),E)),\tilde{h}^{(\ell+1)}=\mathrm{ReLU}(\mathrm{GCNConv}(h^{(\ell)},E)),
h(ℓ+1)=LayerNorm​(h(ℓ)+Dropout​(h~(ℓ+1))).h^{(\ell+1)}=\mathrm{LayerNorm}\left(h^{(\ell)}+\mathrm{Dropout}(\tilde{h}^{(\ell+1)})\right).

这区分了改进是否来自更稳定的残差/归一化 GCN 架构，而不是来自注意力或全局混合。This isolates whether the improvement comes from a more stable residual/normalized GCN architecture rather than from attention or global mixing.

单一消息传递编码器。Unitary message-passing encoder.

unitary_mp 编码器是实值正交/酉式消息传递模型。它不是一个复值酉神经网络；相反，每一层都通过凯莱变换将其自身和消息变换限制为正交。对于可训练的方阵The unitary_mp encoder is a real-valued orthogonal/unitary-style message-passing model. It is not a complex-valued unitary neural network; instead, each layer constrains its self and message transformations to be orthogonal through a Cayley transform. For a trainable square matrixAA，斜对称部分是, the skew-symmetric part is

qv=Qself​hv,ru=Qmsg​hu.q_{v}=Q_{\mathrm{self}}h_{v},\qquad r_{u}=Q_{\mathrm{msg}}h_{u}.

邻居消息是平均聚合的，Neighbor messages are mean-aggregated,

r¯v=1max⁡(1,deg⁡v)​∑u:(u,v)∈Eru,\bar{r}_{v}=\frac{1}{\max(1,\deg v)}\sum_{u:(u,v)\in E}r_{u},

h~v=β​qv+(1−β)​r¯v.\tilde{h}_{v}=\beta q_{v}+(1-\beta)\bar{r}_{v}.

该层输出使用与其他稳定 MP 编码器相同的残差归一化形式：The layer output uses the same residual-normalized form as the other stable MP encoders:

hvout=LayerNorm​(hv+Dropout​(ReLU​(h~v))).h_{v}^{\mathrm{out}}=\mathrm{LayerNorm}\left(h_{v}+\mathrm{Dropout}(\mathrm{ReLU}(\tilde{h}_{v}))\right).

F.3.5 靶向 GatedGCN/ResGCN 消融Targeted GatedGCN/ResGCN Ablation

由于 GatedGCN/ResGCN 在我们的初始测试中表现良好，因此我们对其架构中的不同选择进行了有针对性的消融。Since GatedGCN/ResGCN performed quite well on our initial tests, we performed targeted ablation on the different choices in their architectures.

为了分离 GatedGCN 增益的来源，我们在 GatedGCN 和残差 GCN 编码器的目标变体上重新运行相同的 CORA 协议。烧蚀仅改变编码器； v1/v2 损失、训练/测试分割，以及To separate the source of the GatedGCN gain, we reran the same CORA protocol on targeted variants of the GatedGCN and residual GCN encoders. The ablation changes only the encoder; the v1/v2 losses, train/test split, andkk-medoids 解码不变。-medoids decoding are unchanged.

gate_gcn_fullgated_gcn_full：具有度归一化聚合、残差更新和 LayerNorm 的全矢量门控编码器。: full vector-gated encoder with degree-normalized aggregation, residual update, and LayerNorm.

ated_gcn_no_gategated_gcn_no_gate：删除学习到的源-目标门，同时保留自线性项、聚合、残差更新和 LayerNorm。: removes the learned source-target gate, while keeping the self-linear term, aggregation, residual update, and LayerNorm.

ated_gcn_no_layernormgated_gcn_no_layernorm：删除 LayerNorm，同时保留向量门、残差更新和度归一化聚合。: removes LayerNorm, while keeping the vector gate, residual update, and degree-normalized aggregation.

ated_gcn_no_residualgated_gcn_no_residual：删除残差跳过连接，同时保留向量门、度归一化聚合和 LayerNorm。: removes the residual skip connection, while keeping the vector gate, degree-normalized aggregation, and LayerNorm.

ated_gcn_scalar_gategated_gcn_scalar_gate：将向量值特征门替换为每条边一个标量门。: replaces the vector-valued feature gate with one scalar gate per edge.

ated_gcn_sum_agggated_gcn_sum_agg：使用非归一化总和聚合而不是度归一化均值聚合。: uses unnormalized sum aggregation instead of degree-normalized mean aggregation.

res_gcn：使用 GCNConv、dropout、残差连接和 LayerNorm 的残差 GCN 基线。: residual GCN baseline using GCNConv, dropout, residual connection, and LayerNorm.

res_gcn_param_matched：向残差 GCN 添加 FFN 块，以测试额外容量是否单独解释了 GatedGCN 的改进。: adds an FFN block to residual GCN to test whether extra capacity alone explains the GatedGCN improvement.

v1 no-LayerNorm 变体具有最低的平均值The v1 no-LayerNorm variant has the lowest meank/χk/\chi (1.01±0.051.01\pm 0.05），非常接近完整模型（), very close to the full model (1.01±0.061.01\pm 0.06），而 v2 no-LayerNorm 变体具有最低的 Mono（), and the v2 no-LayerNorm variant has the lowest Mono (0.0189±0.00250.0189\pm 0.0025）。因此，完整的 GatedGCN 设计是稳定的，但证据并未将任何单一门、残差或归一化选择隔离为一致主导。参数匹配的残差 GCN 比更简单的残差 GCN 更差，因此增益不能仅用参数计数来解释。). The full GatedGCN design is therefore stable, but the evidence does not isolate any single gate, residual, or normalization choice as uniformly dominant. The parameter-matched residual GCN is worse than the simpler residual GCN, so the gain is not explained by parameter count alone.

Thus the full-graph results support the geometric picture at low-conflict thresholds, but they also show that the best encoder depends on the graph and on how strict the conflict tolerance is: GPS variants are strongest at the stricter thresholds, GatedGCN is competitive at the loose Cora operating point, and PubMed requires larger palettes despite the same training pipeline.

G.3 具有共享结构特征的 CORA TransferCORA Transfer With Shared Structural Features

实施。Implementation.

原始 BOW 特征无法直接跨 Cora、CiteSeer 和 PubMed 传输，因为特征维度和词汇表是特定于数据集的。为了在保留对比管道的同时测试规模和数据集传输，我们将原始 BOW 替换为具有固定维度的共享结构特征图Raw BOW features cannot be transferred directly across Cora, CiteSeer, and PubMed because the feature dimensions and vocabularies are dataset-specific. To test scale and dataset transfer while preserving the contrastive pipeline, we therefore replace raw BOW by a shared structural feature map with fixed dimension1616。该模型在 Cora 上进行训练并进行评估，无需在 CiteSeer 和 PubMed 上进行重新训练。我们测试了全图调整研究中使用的相同的五个高性能编码器：res_gcn、ated_gcn、unitary_mp、gps_gcn 和 gps_sage。子图和全图传输设置是分开运行的，因为它们的推理分布不同：子图传输测试局部邻域泛化，而全图传输测试学习的表示是否扩展到整个目标图。. The model is trained on Cora and evaluated without retraining on CiteSeer and PubMed. We test the same five high-performing encoders used in the full-graph tuning study: res_gcn, gated_gcn, unitary_mp, gps_gcn, and gps_sage. The subgraph and full-graph transfer settings are run separately because their inference distributions are different: subgraph transfer tests local-neighborhood generalization, while full-graph transfer tests whether the learned representation scales to the whole target graph.

转移实验分离了两种效应。在保留的目标子图上，Cora 训练的结构 功能保留了 PubMed 上的有用性能并部分转移到 CiteSeer，但它们显然是 弱于相同数据集的原始 BOW 训练。在完整的目标图上，转移要困难得多：没有一个 Cora 训练的模型在完整的 CiteSeer 上达到 0.05 阈值，并且是最佳 PubMed 迁移 行需要The transfer experiment separates two effects. On held-out target subgraphs, Cora-trained structural features retain useful performance on PubMed and partially transfer to CiteSeer, but they are clearly weaker than same-dataset raw-BOW training. On full target graphs, transfer is much harder: none of the Cora-trained models reaches the 0.05 threshold on full CiteSeer, and the best PubMed transfer row requiresk0.05=9.8±2.4k_{0.05}=9.8\pm 2.4。因此，结果对于直接全图传输是否定的，但很有用 诊断上：前面部分中相同数据集的高性能取决于目标的拟合 引文图分布，不仅仅是在通用可转移的结构编码器上。. The result is therefore negative for direct full-graph transfer, but useful diagnostically: the high same-dataset performance in the earlier sections depends on fitting the target citation graph distribution, not just on a universally transferable structural encoder.

附录一Appendix I颜色实验COLOR experiments

实施。Implementation.

该基准是作为彩色图的家庭内泛化研究而构建的。对于每个系列，训练图均来自与评估图相同的系列，并且在保留的分布内 (ID) 图以及来自该系列的较大分布外 (OOD) 图上测量性能。这里保留的三个编码器是早期引用实验中最强大的 Cora 衍生选择： ated_gcn、gps_gcn 和 gps_sage，每个编码器都在 v1 和 v2 管道下进行评估。The benchmark is constructed as an in-family generalization study on COLOR graphs. For each family, training graphs are drawn from the same family as the evaluation graphs, and performance is measured on held-out in-distribution (ID) graphs together with larger out-of-distribution (OOD) graphs from that family. The three encoders retained here are the strongest Cora-derived choices from the earlier citation experiments: gated_gcn, gps_gcn, and gps_sage, each evaluated under both the v1 and v2 pipelines.

所有运行都使用相同的对比训练All runs use the same contrastive training andkk-medoids 解码管道，如 Cora 实验中所示。 v1 目标仅是受监督的邻居 InfoNCE，而 v2 则添加了从后来的 Cora 研究继承的调整后的软冲突项。在所有 COLOR 运行中，我们使用 80 个训练周期、通用输入维度-medoids decoding pipeline as in the Cora experiments. The v1 objective is supervised neighbor InfoNCE only, while v2 adds the tuned soft conflict term inherited from the later Cora study. Across all COLOR runs, we use 80 training epochs, common input dimensiond=64d=64和单阈值目标, and mono-threshold target0.050.05.

功能模式。Feature modes.

由于彩色图没有本机节点属性，因此我们比较了两种合成特征结构。Because COLOR graphs have no native node attributes, we compare two synthetic feature constructions.

  • •

    随机：Random:随机单位向量random unit vectorsxi∈ℝ64x_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{64}.

  • •

    结构：Struct:确定性结构描述符deterministic structural descriptors

    xi=ϕstruct​(i),x_{i}=\phi_{\mathrm{struct}}(i),

    哪里whereϕstruct​(i)\phi_{\mathrm{struct}}(i)从四个归一化节点统计数据（度、局部聚类系数、核心数和 PageRank）开始，然后使用固定的非线性基础对它们进行扩展，直到特征维度达到 64。具体来说，对于基标量特征starts from four normalized node statistics—degree, local clustering coefficient, core number, and PageRank—and then expands them with a fixed nonlinear basis until the feature dimension reaches 64. Concretely, for a base scalar featurex∈[0,1]x\in[0,1]，扩张周期经过, the expansion cycles through

    x,x2,sin⁡(π​x),cos⁡(π​x),x,\qquad x^{2},\qquad\sin(\pi x),\qquad\cos(\pi x),

    在四个基本统计数据上重复这些变换，直到填充 64 个坐标。由于基本四维结构向量对于此处使用的编码器来说太小，因此扩展提供了更丰富的确定性输入基础：二次项添加了简单的低阶非线性，而正弦项在标准化结构范围内提供有界非线性响应。repeating these transforms across the four base statistics until 64 coordinates are filled. Since the base four-dimensional structural vector is too small for the encoders used here, the expansion provides a richer deterministic input basis: the quadratic term adds a simple low-order nonlinearity, while the sinusoidal terms provide bounded nonlinear responses across the normalized structural range.

结果。Results.

完成的基准给出了清晰的家庭相关情况。对于书籍图表，随机特征配置是可行的方案：所选的 v1/GPS-SAGE 行具有 OODThe completed benchmark gives a clear family-dependent picture. For book graphs, random-feature configurations are the viable regime: the selected v1/GPS-SAGE row has OODρ=1.08±0.08\rho=1.08\pm 0.08与单声道with Mono=OOD0.0452±0.0034{}_{\mathrm{OOD}}=0.0452\pm 0.0034，而结构特征行未达到命中阈值。对于Myciel图，结构v1/GPS-GCN是选定的配置，带有ID, while the structural-feature rows miss the hit threshold. For Myciel graphs, structural v1/GPS-GCN is the selected configuration, with IDρ=1.45±0.28\rho=1.45\pm 0.28和 OODand OODρ=1.54±0.40\rho=1.54\pm 0.40在保持命中率的同时while keeping hit-rate1.001.00。 Queen 图给出了最强的 OOD 泛化案例：具有随机特征的 v2/GPS-SAGE 给出了 OOD. Queen graphs give the strongest OOD generalization case: v2/GPS-SAGE with random features gives OODρ=0.76±0.02\rho=0.76\pm 0.02和单声道and Mono=OOD0.0471±0.0008{}_{\mathrm{OOD}}=0.0471\pm 0.0008。绝对随机行是可行的低冲突替代方案，但它们不是最好的家庭级别配置。. The abs-random rows are feasible low-conflict alternatives, but they are not the best family-level configurations.

总的来说，这些结果支持三个结论。首先，最好的特征构建取决于家庭：book 和 queen 喜欢随机特征，而 Myciel 喜欢结构特征。其次，在随机初始化系列中，在报告的系列级别比较中，常规 v1/v2 管道比绝对随机管道更强，而绝对随机行充当低冲突稳健性检查。第三，外部基线在此基准测试中仅提供部分信息：当它们完成 ID 系列实例时，它们可以非常强大，但它们重复的 OOD 失败意味着它们不会推翻学习模型比较。Taken together, these results support three conclusions. First, the best feature construction is family-dependent: book and queen favor random features, whereas Myciel favors structural features. Second, within the random-initialized family, the regular v1/v2 pipelines are stronger than their abs-random counterparts on the reported family-level comparisons, while the abs-random rows serve as low-conflict robustness checks. Third, the external baselines are only partially informative in this benchmark: when they finish an ID family instance they can be very strong, but their repeated OOD failures mean that they do not overturn the learned-model comparison.

总体而言，v1abs + GatedGCN 是报告的循环训练基准上最平衡的学习配方。跨越十个种子它到达小套房Overall, v1abs + GatedGCN is the most balanced learned recipe on the reported cycle-trained benchmark. Across ten seeds it reaches small-suitek/χ=1.48±0.10k/\chi=1.48\pm 0.10, 单声道, Mono=0.0216±0.0026=0.0216\pm 0.0026，以及命中率, and hit-rate0.89±0.010.89\pm 0.01;在 20 个大周期达到; on the 20 large cycles it reachesk/χ=1.42±0.22k/\chi=1.42\pm 0.22, 单声道, Mono=0.0133±0.0100=0.0133\pm 0.0100，以及命中率, and hit-rate1.00±0.001.00\pm 0.00。 v2abs GatedGCN 和 UnitaryMP 行的小套件比率略低（. The v2abs GatedGCN and UnitaryMP rows have slightly lower small-suite ratios (1.441.44），但是他们在大周期压力测试上使用了更多的颜色。在小型 40 图子集中，PI-GNN 和热启动 ColoringGNN 基线的颜色效率更高，但两个外部基线在 15 分钟上限下的所有大周期实例上都会超时。因此，运行时分割非常明显：学习模型需要较短的一次性训练阶段，然后快速解码大周期，而直接基线在 7000 节点周期压力测试中变得不可行。), but they use more colors on the large-cycle stress test. On the small 40-graph subset, PI-GNN and the warm-start ColoringGNN baseline are more color-efficient, but both external baselines time out on all large-cycle instances under the 15-minute cap. The runtime split is therefore sharp: learned models require a short one-time training phase and then decode large cycles quickly, whereas the direct baselines become infeasible on the 7000-node cycle stress test.

附录KAppendix K有关实验设置的详细信息Details on Experimental Setups

所有实验均用Python实现。神经网络模型是使用 PyTorch (v2.5.1+cu121) 和 PyTorch Geometric (v2.7.0) 构建的，并通过 NetworkX (v3.4.2) 处理图形构建和综合基准生成。数值计算和数据处理使用NumPy (v2.2.6)、SciPy (v1.15.2) 和pandas (v2.3.3)。对于基于 DGL 的基线重新运行，我们使用 DGL (v1.1.3)。使用默认 PyTorch 堆栈提供的优化和初始化例程以及 AdamW 来训练模型All experiments were implemented in Python. Neural-network models were built using PyTorch (v2.5.1+cu121) and PyTorch Geometric (v2.7.0), with graph construction and synthetic benchmark generation handled through NetworkX (v3.4.2). Numerical computation and data processing used NumPy (v2.2.6), SciPy (v1.15.2), and pandas (v2.3.3). For the DGL-based baseline reruns we used DGL (v1.1.3). Models were trained using the optimization and initialization routines provided by the default PyTorch stack, with AdamW[19]用作我们学习的管道中的优化器。used as the optimizer in our learned pipelines.

我们在本地计算服务器上运行了实验，所使用的硬件配置总结在表中We ran the experiments on a local compute server, and the hardware configuration used is summarized in Table44.

实验使用三组数据集。首先，引文图实验使用 Cora、CiteSeer 和 PubMed 引文图，通过 PyTorch Geometric 中的标准 Planetoid 基准接口加载The experiments use three groups of datasets. First, the citation-graph experiments use the Cora, CiteSeer, and PubMed citation graphs, loaded through the standard Planetoid benchmark interface in PyTorch Geometric[35]。其次，COLOR系列实验使用了book、Myciel和queen graphs；书籍实例取自 CMU COLOR 基准集合. Second, the COLOR-family experiments use book, Myciel, and queen graphs; the book instances are taken from the CMU COLOR benchmark collection[12]，而 Myciel 和 queen 家族是根据其标准图形结构以编程方式生成的。第三，循环实验使用合成循环图进行训练和保留评估，以及额外的手动指定的基准图，例如完整图、完整二分图、轮图、Kneser图、Mycielski图、Petersen、二十面体和非常大的循环；这些图是通过 NetworkX 或通过我们代码库中的显式图构造实用程序生成的。, while the Myciel and queen families are generated programmatically from their standard graph constructions. Third, the cycle experiments use synthetic cycle graphs for training and held-out evaluation, together with additional manually specified benchmark graphs such as complete graphs, complete bipartite graphs, wheel graphs, Kneser graphs, Mycielski graphs, Petersen, Icosahedral, and very large cycles; these graphs are generated through NetworkX or through explicit graph-construction utilities in our codebase.
